title: Scripted Effects & Triggers
intro: Reusable named blocks dispatched by name (common/scripted_effects/ + common/scripted_triggers/). Internal HOI4 symbols, not player-facing text.
emptyAll: No scripted effects or triggers yet. Create a reusable named block here.
selectHint: Select a scripted effect or trigger, or create a new one.
nameHint: The symbol other scripts call by name. Must be unique within its kind.
sourceFileHint: Mod-relative path this block exports to. Leave blank for an auto-named file.
bodyHint: Everything between the braces. Round-trips verbatim — the export wraps it back into the named block automatically.
emptyHeroTitle: No scripted effects or triggers yet
emptyHeroDesc: Reusable named blocks you can call anywhere by name. Start with your first one.
